why.title: Why these 2?
why.intro: [DUMMY] We chose on three tests: correlation with engagement, size of the gap, and whether the team can move it without waiting for the wider company.

bullets.text: Highest correlation and fully in our control.
Largest retention risk signal, and it compounds everything else.

why.closing: Sequence: decisions first, because it unlocks trust. Workload second, because it needs the stop list.
